method: Adaptive full-parameter-domain certificate using exact nearest-triangle samples and conservative 1-Lipschitz distance lower bounds. Spherical cell displacement bound = dr/2 + rMax*dPolar/2 + rMax*sin(polarMax)*dAzimuth/2. Float precision is not interval arithmetic; >.00001 numerical buffer required above internal .46 target.
staticIncludes: Actual runtime-pruned scene, all three rigid pilot landmarks, both original and 25k specimen geometries conservatively superposed, sand and limestone. Excludes animated fish.
